 ⌕                                                          0/0 · Recently used
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Potato keeps the long commands you can never remember, and hands them back
   to your shell.

   a  Add your first command
   ↵  Hand it to your shell
   y  Copy it instead

   Write {{name}} or {{name=default}} in a command and potato asks for the
   value before handing it over.
